# Synodus

> Synodus is a global custom software development partner specializing in Web3, blockchain, and enterprise solutions across finance, healthcare, and public sector industries.

Based in Vietnam with offices in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, Synodus delivers full-cycle development services including mobile and web applications, blockchain/Web3 solutions, low-code automation, and data analytics. The company serves enterprise clients like Unilever, BOC Aviation, and KPMG with dedicated teams and offshore development models.

## Key Topics

- Custom Software Development
- Blockchain & Web3
- Mobile App Development
- Web App Development
- MVP Development
- Low-Code Development
- Fintech Solutions
- Data Analytics & BI
- Digital Transformation

- Enterprise Solutions

- Smart Contracts

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://synodus.com/services): Synodus core services: Custom software, Web3, blockchain, DevOps, and full-cycle development
- [Custom Software Development](https://synodus.com/services): End-to-end custom software solutions tailored to business goals
- [Web App Development](https://synodus.com/services/web-app-development): Web app development: PWA, MVP, API integration, UI/UX design with dedicated teams
- [Mobile App Development](https://synodus.com/services/mobile-app-development): Mobile app development for iOS, Android, fintech, healthcare with blockchain support
- [Blockchain & Web3 Development](https://synodus.com/services/blockchain): Blockchain services: Web3, DeFi, NFTs, smart contracts on Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana
- [Low-Code Development](https://synodus.com/services/low-code): Low-code development for workflow automation, legacy modernization with Microsoft tools
- [Data Analytics & BI](https://synodus.com/services/data-analytics): Data analytics: BI dashboards, machine learning, predictive analytics for informed decisions

## Industry Solutions

- [Industries Overview](https://synodus.com/industries): Industry solutions: Finance, healthcare, public sector, travel, transportation sector expertise
- [Finance & Banking](https://synodus.com/industries/finance-banking): Fintech solutions for banking, API integration, MVP launch, scalable apps with BI
- [Healthcare](https://synodus.com/industries/healthcare): Healthcare software: HIPAA-compliant EHR/EMR integration, patient data security, telemedicine
- [Public Sector](https://synodus.com/industries/public-sector): Public sector solutions: Smart city, digital transformation, citizen engagement, blockchain
- [Travel & Logistics](https://synodus.com/industries/transportation): Travel/logistics solutions for aviation, transportation with blockchain and BI reports
- [Retail](https://synodus.com/industries/retail): Retail solutions: E-commerce, digital transformation, data analytics, UI/UX design
